messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-INC-20250301 - pg_conn_utilization > 95% on db-prod-primary :rotating_light:
PagerDuty Bot: Notification sent to escalation policy 'eng-oncall' (2 min repeat).
Alex (oncall): acked via PagerDuty, looking...
Alex (oncall): seeing connection spikes, pg_accept_queue rising, many 'idle in transaction' sessions.
Priya (sre): @Alex can you dump top queries? also any recent deploys to writes table?
Alex (oncall): nothing in deploy logs 10m ago. running quick query:
```
SELECT pid, usename, state, query_start, now()-query_start AS age, query FROM pg_stat_activity ORDER BY age DESC LIMIT 20;
```
Matt (db): I'm seeing a batch worker from payments service hammering INSERTS to orders. lots of small transactions not using COPY.
Sara (prod-eng): that's AcmeCorp tenant traffic — they rolled a retry loop earlier today. CS-Bot: reported errors for AcmeCorp via support ticket #8352.
Priya (sre): mitigation idea: kill the top runaway txs, enable statement_timeout=30s for app role, and scale connection proxy.
Alex (oncall): killing 40 long txs now (progressively). will monitor.
PagerDuty Bot: PagerDuty alert re-fired (repeat) — escalation still active.
Alex (oncall): acked again, but PD is re-firing because incident-bot didn't see the ack in its window (weird).
Priya (sre): PD re-fire noise is masking real signal. please hold further acks until we confirm steady state.
Matt (db): pgbouncer pools near max_clients. we can bump pool_size by +50 but that will increase DB connections. prefer to enforce app-side pooling.
Sara (prod-eng): can we throttle the AcmeCorp job from infra? we can flip the feature flag to disable heavy retries.
Alex (oncall): flag toggle attempt in progress — calling deploy toggle endpoint: `curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle -d '{"flag":"acme-retries","state":"off"}'`
Alex (oncall): toggle applied, confirm responses dropping. connection count trending down.
Priya (sre): good. also temporarily set DB role limit:
```
ALTER ROLE app_read WRITE; -- (example placeholder)
-- Instead run: SET ROLE app_user; SET statement_timeout = '30s';
```
Matt (db): promoted a read-replica to assist writes? not safe. instead I added a new pgbouncer instance behind the pool to absorb transient bursts.
PagerDuty Bot: Incident status: acknowledged by Alex (oncall). next PD re-fire scheduled in 5m.
Alex (oncall): leaving a handoff: if connections climb above 850, start DB throttling rule and notify Matt directly.
Priya (sre): created internal ticket INF-2025-001 and assigned to Matt + Alex for follow-up. suggested postmortem items: rate-limit client retries, add connection caps, and alert correlation to avoid PD loops.
CS-Bot: Notified customer success — AcmeCorp impacted: checkout failures ~6% for 12m window. outreach queued.
Sara (prod-eng): monitoring dashboards show 95% reduction in error rate after flag flip.
Alex (oncall): last check: connections 320, accept_queue 0, error rate back to baseline. closing thread but will keep ticket open. :white_check_mark:
PagerDuty Bot: Incident resolved by ack + actions; auto-close in 1h unless reopened.
